notes.title: UPDATE - Blaster Master Zero 2 - New DLC & Bug fixed
notes.content:
* DLC character Empress from "Dragon Marked for Death" has been added.

    Adds EMPRESS from "Dragon Marked for Death" as a playable character in EX Character Mode.
    Board the Dragonblood Tank, "D-ATTACKER,"
    and use your Dragon Skills to slay any mutants that stand in your way!

* Added an option to force the game to start in windowed mode.

    [ Forces the game to start in windowed mode. ]
    1. Right-click on the game title under the Library in Steam and select Properties.
    2. Under the General tab click the Set launch options... button.
    3. Enter "-windowed" into the launch options field and click OK.
    4. Close the Properties window and launch the game.

* An issue with fullscreen display on 4K monitors has been fixed.

* Various issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Blaster Master Zero 2 - Bug Fix Notice
notes.content:
The following update were distributed on 12/1/2019 22:30 PST and 12/3/2019 21:40 PST.
(Build 4449665 & Build 4456596)

* Fixed an issue that caused the application to crash in specific scenes when playing in Windows XP SP3 compatibility mode etc.
* Fixed some typographical errors in the DLC Playable Character: Copen from "Luminous Avenger iX".
* In addition, minor issues in the game have been fixed so that you can play comfortably.

The bug that the application crashes in an important scene in the game has also been resolved.
We hope you will try it out.

Thank you.
